import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-qa-admin', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `

💬 Q&A Management

{{editingId ? 'Edit' : 'Add New'}} Question

TitleAuthorCategoryAnswersStatusActions
{{q.title}}{{q.author}}{{q.category}} {{q.answerCount}} {{q.isAnswered ? 'Answered' : 'Open'}}
` }) export class QaAdminComponent { showForm = false; editingId: number | null = null; formData = { title: '', author: '', category: '', content: '', answerCount: 0, isAnswered: false }; questions: any[] = [ { id: 1, title: 'How to use Java Streams?', author: 'John Doe', category: 'Java', content: 'Can someone explain Java Streams?', answerCount: 3, isAnswered: true }, { id: 2, title: 'SQL JOIN vs Subquery', author: 'Jane Smith', category: 'SQL', content: 'Which is better for performance?', answerCount: 2, isAnswered: true }, { id: 3, title: 'React useEffect cleanup', author: 'Mike Johnson', category: 'React', content: 'How to properly cleanup useEffect?', answerCount: 0, isAnswered: false }, ]; save() { if (this.editingId) { const i = this.questions.findIndex(q => q.id === this.editingId); if (i > -1) this.questions[i] = { ...this.formData, id: this.editingId }; } else { this.questions.push({ ...this.formData, id: Date.now() }); } this.resetForm(); } edit(q: any) { this.editingId = q.id; this.formData = { ...q }; delete (this.formData as any).id; this.showForm = true; } delete(q: any) { if (confirm('Delete?')) this.questions = this.questions.filter(x => x.id !== q.id); } resetForm() { this.formData = { title: '', author: '', category: '', content: '', answerCount: 0, isAnswered: false }; this.editingId = null; this.showForm = false; } }
